after.description: [GO, UP, MX] Live Preview of Content in CMS — enable content authors editing in Contentstack CMS to see their changes reflected in real-time on the preview site without requiring a full page reload or manual publish. This applies across GO Transit, UP Express, and MX brand sites.
after.title: [GO, UP, MX] Live Preview of Content in CMS

notes: Novel capability — Live Preview does not exist in the codebase. The attachment point is useContent, the central hook consumed by 236+ components. Live Preview must plug into this hook so that all downstream Contentstack components (ContentstackLink, ContentstackImage, ContentstackTable, ContentstackContentCards, etc.) automatically receive real-time content updates from the CMS preview session. No split needed — single integration concern with 0 existing ACs.

notes: Openspec provided 0 acceptance criteria, so all 14 are new. I examined the referenced files (useContent.ts, ContentstackContext.tsx, ContentstackLink.tsx, contentCard.ts) to understand the data flow: useContent is the central hook that fetches from Contentstack via ContentstackContext, and all 236+ components consume it. ACs are structured around observable outcomes: real-time update delivery, fallback to published content, multi-brand support (GO/UP/MX), connection resilience, security (no draft leakage), edge cases (missing/added fields, idle sessions, cross-page navigation), and progressive enhancement. Key areas flagged for human attention: Contentstack SDK version compatibility and the exact mechanism for distinguishing preview vs public visitors.
